invariants.rationale: The method returns a map built from distinct partition paths, so the result should not be null.
writeResult is required to obtain write statuses; it must not be null at this point.
If there are write statuses, there will be partition paths and thus the result will not be empty, and vice versa.
All distinct partition paths found in write statuses serve as keys in the result.
The method uses getAllExistingFileIds to populate values, so lists in the result should not be null.
